scope: Per-row related aggregates on two fixed SQLite fixtures; checks count parent results, not independently authored test cases. No speed or general superiority ranking.
limitations: Empty NULL/zero/NaN results are reported separately. Numeric fixture totals stay within the safe integer range for the shared comparison.
The independent runtime tests cover exact large integers, invalid storage, collation and domain filters separately.
Root/group related aggregates, other engines, DISTINCT, HAVING and per-selector filters are outside this comparison.

cases.name: count children
cases.orangeSql: select "cp"."id" as "scp0","cp"."label" as "scp1","y0".amount as value from "cp" "cp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "x1"."parentId",count("x1"."id") as amount FROM "cc" "x1"  GROUP BY "x1"."parentId") "y0" ON ("cp"."id"="y0"."parentId") order by "cp"."id"

cases.name: count nonnull
cases.orangeSql: select "cp"."id" as "scp0","cp"."label" as "scp1","y0".amount as value from "cp" "cp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "x1"."parentId",count("x1"."amount") as amount FROM "cc" "x1"  GROUP BY "x1"."parentId") "y0" ON ("cp"."id"="y0"."parentId") order by "cp"."id"

cases.name: sum integers
cases.orangeSql: select "cp"."id" as "scp0","cp"."label" as "scp1",COALESCE("y0".amount, 0) as "value" from "cp" "cp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "x1"."parentId",sum("x1"."amount") as amount FROM "cc" "x1"  GROUP BY "x1"."parentId") "y0" ON ("cp"."id"="y0"."parentId") order by "cp"."id"
